# Contributing

Thank you for helping improve neurwerk.base - Keycloak Theme.

## Issues

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/neurwerk/k8s_stack_keycloak_theme/issues) for reproducible bugs and clearly scoped feature requests. Check for an existing issue first and keep each report short and focused. Include relevant versions and reproduction steps when available. Never include secrets or private data.

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately by following [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Pull requests

Keep changes focused and link any related issue. Update affected documentation and tests, run the checks defined in the repository's CI workflows, and include the results in the pull request. Never commit credentials, private data, or generated caches.
